figures.title: Inference work
figures.caption: Each selected token gates the next step of that sequence.
figures.caption_cn: 每个序列都要用已选 token 才能执行下一步。

figures.title: Training work
en: Saved values connect forward and backward
zh: 保存值连接前向与反向
figures.caption: Training adds gradient dependencies and persistent optimizer state.
figures.caption_cn: 训练增加梯度依赖与持久优化器状态。

figures.title: The experiment loop
en: Keep the workload and quality contract fixed
zh: 保持工作负载与质量契约不变
figures.caption: A failed prediction is useful evidence about the missing cost.
figures.caption_cn: 预测失败也能帮助发现遗漏的开销。

figures.title: A minimal traffic model
en: Read A and B; accumulate and write C
zh: 读取 A、B，累加并写入 C
figures.caption: This minimal traffic picture omits cache misses, packing and repeated tile loads.
figures.caption_cn: 最小流量图没有计入缓存缺失、打包与重复加载。

figures.title: Capacity is a separate constraint
en: All live allocations must fit the capacity budget
zh: 所有同时存活的分配必须符合容量预算
figures.caption: Equal boxes name ledger terms; their widths do not encode bytes.
figures.caption_cn: 等宽方框只标记预算项，宽度不代表字节数。

figures.title: Amdahl’s limit
en: The unchanged portion limits end-to-end speedup
zh: 未改变部分限制端到端加速比
figures.caption: Analytical Amdahl model with a fixed workload.
figures.caption_cn: 固定工作负载下的 Amdahl 分析模型。

figures.title: A decoder block supplies repeatable work
figures.title_cn: 解码器块提供可重复的工作
en: Weights, activations and KV have different lifetimes
zh: 权重、激活和 KV 的生命周期不同
figures.caption: A conceptual decoder block, not a specification of every model.
figures.caption_cn: 概念性的解码器块，并非所有模型的结构规范。

figures.title: KV caching
figures.caption: Caching avoids old K/V projection work; new queries still attend to allowed history.
figures.caption_cn: 缓存避免重算旧 K/V 投影；新查询仍访问允许的历史。

figures.title: MHA, MQA and GQA
figures.caption: Illustrative GQA: four query heads share two K/V groups.
figures.caption_cn: GQA 示例：四个查询头共享两个 K/V 组。

figures.title: A measurement contract
figures.caption: Fix inputs, boundaries, warm-up, synchronization and the sample population.
figures.caption_cn: 固定输入、边界、预热、同步方式和样本总体。

figures.title: Cold and warm execution
figures.caption: Report cold and warm costs separately; define what was reused.
figures.caption_cn: 分别报告冷启动与热执行成本，并说明复用了什么。

figures.title: Critical path and overlap
en: Only exposed dependencies set the finish time
zh: 只有暴露的依赖决定结束时间
figures.caption: Parallel phase durations cannot simply be added.
figures.caption_cn: 不能直接相加并行阶段的时长。

figures.title: CPU affinity and NUMA
figures.caption: Illustrative placement graph; inspect the actual CPU and device topology.
figures.caption_cn: 示意放置关系；实际实验需要检查 CPU 与设备拓扑。

figures.title: Pageable and pinned host memory
figures.title_cn: 可分页内存与锁页内存
figures.caption: Pinning enables relevant transfer paths but does not guarantee overlap.
figures.caption_cn: 固定页支持相应传输路径，但不保证发生重叠。

figures.title: Prefetch and backpressure
zh: 反压限制待处理工作量
figures.caption: Prefetch depth trades starvation risk against retained memory and queueing.
figures.caption_cn: 预取深度在供给不足、内存占用与排队之间权衡。

figures.title: Views and copies
figures.caption: Metadata changes do not necessarily move tensor bytes.
figures.caption_cn: 元数据变化并不一定搬移张量字节。

figures.title: A linear layer backward
en: Saved X and W feed different backward paths
zh: 保存的 X、W 进入不同反向路径
figures.caption: A linear-layer dependency picture; bias and batching details are omitted.
figures.caption_cn: 线性层的依赖示意；省略偏置与批处理细节。

figures.title: Gradient accumulation
en: Match loss scaling and effective batch
zh: 匹配损失缩放与有效批大小
figures.caption: Illustrative two-microbatch accumulation, not two optimizer updates.
figures.caption_cn: 两个微批累加的示例，并非两次优化器更新。

figures.title: Guards and specialization
en: A miss may trigger another specialization
zh: 失配可能触发新的特化
figures.caption: The real compiler chooses reuse, recompilation or fallback under its configuration.
figures.caption_cn: 实际编译器按配置选择复用、重编译或回退。

figures.title: Graph breaks
figures.caption: A graph break splits optimization regions; it is distinct from an input guard miss.
figures.caption_cn: 图中断拆分优化区域，与输入守卫失配不同。

figures.title: Fusion, graph replay and megakernels
figures.title_cn: 融合、图重放与巨型内核
figures.caption: Fusion changes intermediate work; replay primarily targets launch orchestration.
figures.caption_cn: 融合改变中间工作；重放主要优化启动编排。

figures.title: Tail handling
figures.caption: Lane numbers are a small teaching subset, not a hardware warp-width claim.
figures.caption_cn: 线程编号只是教学子集，不表示硬件 warp 宽度。

figures.title: Coalesced access
en: Element indices accessed by adjacent lanes
zh: 相邻线程访问的元素索引
figures.caption: The address pattern matters; transaction counts depend on alignment and architecture.
figures.caption_cn: 地址模式很重要；事务数量还取决于对齐与架构。

figures.title: Registers and occupancy
zh: 资源限制约束同时驻留的工作
figures.caption: These are joint resource constraints, not additive bytes or a universal occupancy formula.
figures.caption_cn: 这些是联合资源约束，不是可相加字节或通用占用率公式。

figures.title: RMSNorm
en: Scale each xᵢ by the same row statistic
zh: 用同一个行统计量缩放各 xᵢ
figures.caption: Declare epsilon placement, accumulation dtype and tail handling.
figures.caption_cn: 明确 epsilon 的位置、累加精度与尾部处理。

figures.title: Stable softmax
figures.caption: Subtracting the row maximum improves numerical range; handle nonfinite inputs explicitly.
figures.caption_cn: 减去行最大值改善数值范围；非有限输入需另定策略。

figures.title: Fusion tradeoffs
figures.caption: Avoided intermediate traffic can trade against registers, occupancy and specialization.
figures.caption_cn: 减少中间流量的代价可能是寄存器、占用率与特化成本。

figures.title: Naive repeated reads
en: Naive work can reload values for neighboring outputs
zh: 朴素计算可能为相邻输出反复加载相同值
figures.caption: Tiling seeks reuse; cache behavior must still be measured.
figures.caption_cn: 分块旨在复用数据；缓存行为仍需测量。

figures.title: Registers hold accumulated outputs
figures.title_cn: 寄存器保存累加的输出
en: Accumulator retained across the K loop
zh: 累加器跨 K 循环保留
figures.caption: A logical accumulator lifetime; register pressure depends on the implementation.
figures.caption_cn: 累加器生命周期示意；寄存器压力取决于具体实现。

figures.title: Epilogue fusion
figures.caption: Fuse supported epilogue operations without changing the numerical contract.
figures.caption_cn: 在保持数值契约的前提下融合受支持的尾处理。

figures.title: A serial tile loop
figures.caption: Serial tile dependencies expose transfer before each compute phase.
figures.caption_cn: 串行分块依赖让每次计算前的传输直接暴露。

figures.title: A pipelined tile loop
figures.caption: Read only after ready; reuse a buffer only after its consumer releases it.
figures.caption_cn: 就绪后才能读取；消费者释放后才能复用缓冲区。

figures.title: Pipeline hazards
en: No overwrite while the consumer holds the buffer
zh: 消费者持有缓冲区时禁止覆盖
figures.caption: The actual implementation must satisfy the target pipeline and barrier protocol.
figures.caption_cn: 具体实现必须遵守目标平台的流水线与屏障协议。

figures.title: A materialized path
figures.caption: This materialized path exposes large score/probability intermediates in memory.
figures.caption_cn: 物化路径会在内存中产生较大的分数与概率中间矩阵。

figures.title: Online state
en: Rescale old state and merge the new tile
zh: 重缩放旧状态，再合并新块
figures.caption: Boxes identify online state, not additive memory sizes.
figures.caption_cn: 方框标记在线状态，不表示可相加的内存大小。
figures.formula: m′ = max(m, m_tile),  O = u / ℓ

figures.title: Causal masking
en: All-masked rows require a defined contract
zh: 允许：键位置 ≤ 查询位置
全屏蔽行需要明确数值契约
figures.caption: A causal mask changes allowed pairs, not the representation of KV blocks.
figures.caption_cn: 因果掩码改变允许配对的位置，不等于 KV 分块表示。

figures.title: FlashAttention-2: work partitioning
figures.caption: Conceptual work partitioning; actual warp ownership is kernel-specific.
figures.caption_cn: 工作划分示意；实际 warp 所有权由内核决定。

figures.title: Tile order and locality
en: Changing traversal can change locality and retained state
zh: 遍历变化会影响局部性与保留状态
figures.caption: A locality hypothesis needs a matched shape, mask and cache experiment.
figures.caption_cn: 局部性假设需要匹配形状、掩码与缓存条件后验证。

figures.title: Backend selection
en: Shape, dtype, mask and layout select the path
zh: 形状、类型、掩码与布局共同选择路径
figures.caption: Backend labels alone do not identify which kernel actually ran.
figures.caption_cn: 后端名称本身无法说明实际运行了哪个内核。

figures.title: Range and resolution
en: Range and spacing are separate format choices
zh: 范围与数值间距是不同的格式选择
figures.caption: Symbolic number line; ticks do not reproduce any specific floating-point encoding.
figures.caption_cn: 符号数轴；刻度不对应特定浮点编码。

figures.title: A symmetric teaching quantizer
figures.title_cn: 一个对称的教学用量化器
figures.caption: Teaching symmetric quantizer; saturation changes the error contract.
figures.caption_cn: 教学对称量化器；饱和截断会改变误差契约。

figures.title: Outlier exercise
figures.caption: Grouping trades local error against scale storage and supported kernel layouts.
figures.caption_cn: 分组在局部误差、缩放存储与内核布局支持之间权衡。

figures.title: Block-scaled formats
en: Values and matching scales feed the kernel
zh: 数值与对应缩放一起进入内核
figures.caption: Block shape, scale format and accumulation mode must match the kernel.
figures.caption_cn: 分块形状、缩放格式与累加方式必须匹配内核。

figures.title: Fused dequantize GEMM: Marlin
figures.caption: Conceptual fused dequantization; supported packing and shapes remain kernel-specific.
figures.caption_cn: 融合反量化示意；打包与形状支持仍由内核决定。

figures.title: Serving quality gate
figures.caption: Operator error, model quality and serving SLOs require separate acceptance checks.
figures.caption_cn: 算子误差、模型质量与服务 SLO 需要分别验收。

figures.title: A request state machine
en: Admission and cleanup own the KV lifetime
zh: 准入与清理负责 KV 生命周期
figures.caption: Request-state transitions need resource accounting and a safe reclaim boundary.
figures.caption_cn: 请求状态迁移需要资源统计与安全回收边界。

figures.title: Iteration-level batching
figures.caption: Constructed iteration example; each live sequence keeps its token dependencies.
figures.caption_cn: 构造的迭代示例；每个存活序列仍保留 token 依赖。

figures.title: Physical blocks and logical positions
figures.caption: Constructed non-contiguous mapping; page placement differs from attention arithmetic.
figures.caption_cn: 构造的非连续映射；页面放置与注意力计算量不同。

figures.title: Six cache layers
zh: 省去编译 / 启动设置
figures.caption: Each cached object avoids different work and needs its own validity contract.
figures.caption_cn: 不同缓存对象省去不同工作，并需要各自的有效性契约。

figures.title: A prefix is a computation identity
en: Compatible causal computation determines a cache hit
zh: 缓存命中取决于兼容的因果计算
figures.caption: These are joint identity conditions, not additive bytes.
figures.caption_cn: 这些是联合身份条件，不是可相加的字节。

figures.title: Ownership and eviction
en: Retain shared blocks until every live owner releases them
zh: 所有存活持有者都释放之后，才能回收共享块
figures.caption: Completion, references and in-flight device access must all permit reuse.
figures.caption_cn: 完成状态、引用与在途设备访问都必须允许复用。

figures.title: Interference example
figures.caption: Schematic interference: a long admitted prefill can delay existing decode work.
figures.caption_cn: 干扰示意：获准执行的长预填充会延迟已有解码。

figures.title: Token budgets are not time budgets
figures.title_cn: token 预算不是时间预算
figures.caption: Token budgets alone do not fix elapsed time or memory traffic.
figures.caption_cn: 仅有 token 预算无法固定耗时或内存流量。

figures.title: Goodput definition
en: Count useful completions over the observation interval
zh: 满足所定 SLO 的完成请求
在观测区间内统计有用完成量
figures.caption: Declare TTFT/TPOT gates and include failures and unfinished requests.
figures.caption_cn: 声明 TTFT/TPOT 门槛，并计入失败与未完成请求。

figures.title: Disaggregated path
figures.caption: Separating phase placement adds transfer, queues and an ownership handoff.
figures.caption_cn: 分离阶段放置会增加传输、排队与所有权交接。

figures.title: Ownership handoff
en: No premature source reuse during the handoff
zh: 交接期间禁止过早复用源端状态
figures.caption: A logical handoff contract; transport completion and consumer readiness need explicit meaning.
figures.caption_cn: 逻辑交接契约；传输完成与消费者就绪需分别定义。

figures.title: Layout compatibility
en: Model, heads, positions and partitioning must agree
zh: 模型、头、位置与分区方式必须一致
figures.caption: A connector cannot infer compatibility from equal byte counts alone.
figures.caption_cn: 连接器不能仅凭字节数相同判断兼容。

figures.title: The distributed path
figures.caption: The routed pipeline exposes network traffic and expert load imbalance.
figures.caption_cn: 路由流水线会暴露网络流量与专家负载不均。

figures.title: Permutation and restoration
figures.caption: Illustrative top-1 permutation; retain indices to restore original token order.
figures.caption_cn: Top-1 排列示例；需保留索引以恢复原始 token 顺序。

figures.title: Grouped GEMM opportunity
en: Different token counts create different GEMM shapes
zh: 不同 token 数形成不同 GEMM 形状
figures.caption: Grouped execution changes launch organization; it does not remove routing skew.
figures.caption_cn: 分组执行改变启动组织方式，不会消除路由倾斜。

figures.title: Acceptance rule
en: Accept a sampled draft token with the declared probability
zh: 按规定概率接受采样得到的草稿 token
figures.caption: This is the sampling contract, distinct from greedy token matching.
figures.caption_cn: 这是采样契约，与贪心 token 匹配不同。

figures.title: Correction rule
en: On rejection, sample the normalized positive residual
zh: 拒绝时，从正残差归一化后的分布采样
figures.caption: Handle zero denominators and support conditions explicitly.
figures.caption_cn: 显式处理零分母与概率支持集条件。

figures.title: From one token to a sequence
figures.title_cn: 从单个 token 到序列
en: Correct first rejection; drop later KV
zh: 校正首次拒绝，并丢弃后续 KV
figures.caption: Constructed example: two accepted tokens, then a rejection and an uncommitted tail.
figures.caption_cn: 构造示例：接受两个 token，随后拒绝，尾部不提交。

figures.title: Byte-seconds
en: Waiting retains capacity even when no model kernel executes
zh: 保留的 KV 字节 B
没有模型内核执行时，等待仍占用容量
figures.caption: A retained-capacity ledger, not a measured energy estimate.
figures.caption_cn: 保留容量的预算项，并非实测能耗。

figures.title: Shared branches
figures.caption: Shared prefix storage remains live while another compatible branch owns it.
figures.caption_cn: 另一个兼容分支仍持有前缀时，共享存储继续存活。

figures.title: Tool freshness is another layer
figures.title_cn: 工具结果的新鲜度是另一层
figures.caption: A computation cache hit does not establish freshness of an external tool result.
figures.caption_cn: 计算缓存命中不能证明外部工具结果仍然新鲜。

figures.title: Export makes assumptions explicit
en: The artifact carries assumptions beyond tensor values
zh: 产物的假设不止张量数值本身
figures.caption: Recheck the pinned producer/loader version; this diagram does not change its API.
figures.caption_cn: 需核对固定版本的生产端与加载端；本图不更改 API。

figures.title: Graph archive versus compiled archive
figures.caption: A saved graph and an executable package have different compatibility boundaries.
figures.caption_cn: 保存的图与可执行包有不同的兼容边界。

figures.title: Four timing phases
figures.caption: Keep costs separate and report the number of requests that amortize compilation.
figures.caption_cn: 分别统计成本，并说明需要多少请求摊销编译。

figures.title: Program and separate data
en: Program and data packaging are target/version dependent
zh: 程序与数据打包取决于目标与版本
figures.caption: The format and deployment contract remain those of the pinned ExecuTorch release.
figures.caption_cn: 格式与部署契约仍以课件固定的 ExecuTorch 版本为准。

figures.title: Memory planning
figures.caption: Static planning depends on graph, shapes, aliases and backend requirements.
figures.caption_cn: 静态规划取决于图、形状、别名与后端要求。

figures.title: A CPU fallback can be expensive
figures.title_cn: CPU 回退可能代价高昂
figures.caption: A fallback boundary may add synchronization and transfers beyond operator time.
figures.caption_cn: 回退边界可能在算子耗时外增加同步与传输。

figures.title: GPU mechanism questions
en: Match each bottleneck hypothesis to a hardware boundary
zh: 将每个瓶颈假设对应到硬件边界
figures.caption: Joint system constraints, not additive rates or a new Rubin specification.
figures.caption_cn: 系统联合约束，不是可相加速率或新增 Rubin 规格。

figures.title: A training execution map
en: Trace compute, memory and network responsibilities
zh: 跟踪计算、内存与网络职责
figures.caption: A generic distributed training map; actual overlap follows the chosen stack.
figures.caption_cn: 通用分布式训练图；实际重叠取决于所用执行栈。

figures.title: An inference execution map
figures.caption: Software libraries cover different responsibilities; platform support must be verified.
figures.caption_cn: 软件库负责不同职责；平台支持需要逐项确认。

figures.title: ZeRO stages
en: Three rank rows: full bars replicate, offset slices partition
zh: 三个 rank 行：满条表示复制，错开的切片表示分片
figures.caption: Constructed three-rank sketch; use actual dtypes and transient buffers for memory estimates.
figures.caption_cn: 构造的三 rank 示例；内存估算需使用真实类型并计入临时缓冲区。

figures.title: Peak is not persistent state
en: Peak depends on allocations whose lifetimes overlap
zh: 峰值取决于生命周期重叠的分配
figures.caption: Equal boxes identify terms, not their sizes; persistent state alone misses the peak.
figures.caption_cn: 等宽方框只标记项目；仅统计持久状态会遗漏峰值。

figures.title: Gradient accumulation
en: Match loss scaling and effective batch
zh: 匹配损失缩放与有效批大小
figures.caption: Schematic accumulation cycle; communication suppression is implementation-specific.
figures.caption_cn: 累加循环示意；是否延后通信取决于实现。

figures.title: A ring teaching model
figures.caption: Conceptual ring, not a promise about NCCL algorithm selection or physical routing.
figures.caption_cn: 概念环，并不保证 NCCL 选择该算法或物理路由。

figures.title: Overlap is constrained by readiness
figures.title_cn: 重叠受数据就绪的约束
figures.caption: A bucket can communicate only after its gradients are ready on participating ranks.
figures.caption_cn: 只有参与 rank 的梯度就绪后，桶才能开始通信。

figures.title: Bucket trade-off
figures.caption: The best bucket size balances readiness, launch cost and transport efficiency.
figures.caption_cn: 桶大小需要平衡就绪时间、启动成本与传输效率。

figures.title: Tensor parallel matrix flow
figures.title_cn: 张量并行的矩阵数据流
en: The collective depends on row/column partitioning
zh: 通信方式取决于按行还是按列分片
figures.caption: A conceptual two-way tensor partition; specify actual tensor layouts and collectives.
figures.caption_cn: 两路张量分区示意；实际布局与集合通信需另行明确。

figures.title: Pipeline parallel flow
figures.caption: Forward-only pipeline sketch; backward scheduling adds dependencies and live activations.
figures.caption_cn: 仅示意前向流水；反向调度还会增加依赖与存活激活。

figures.title: Recomputation trades resources
figures.caption: Reduced retained memory costs recomputation and may alter RNG requirements.
figures.caption_cn: 减少保留内存需要额外重计算，也可能改变 RNG 要求。

figures.title: Process topology
en: A rank participates in several explicitly constructed groups
zh: 一个 rank 参与多个明确构造的进程组
figures.caption: Responsibility sketch only; real process groups overlap and require an explicit mesh.
figures.caption_cn: 仅示意职责；真实进程组会交叠，需要明确的网格定义。

figures.title: Model transformation boundary
figures.caption: Read the pinned stack to verify actual transformation and initialization order.
figures.caption_cn: 实际变换与初始化顺序必须检查固定版本源码。

figures.title: Expert groups are separate
en: Do not infer expert groups from tensor-parallel names alone
zh: 不能仅凭张量并行名称推断专家组
figures.caption: Conceptual responsibilities; record the real group constructor and membership.
figures.caption_cn: 概念职责图；需记录真实组构造函数与成员。

figures.title: A safe snapshot boundary
en: Publish only a consistent state boundary
zh: 只发布一致的状态边界
figures.caption: Snapshot consistency and durability are separate obligations.
figures.caption_cn: 快照一致性与持久性是不同职责。

figures.title: Async checkpoint stages
figures.caption: Async save can overlap only after the snapshot data is safely staged.
figures.caption_cn: 只有安全暂存快照数据后，异步保存才能与训练重叠。

figures.title: Mutation hazard
figures.caption: A mutation hazard schematic; no storage durability or distributed commit is implied.
figures.caption_cn: 修改风险示意；不代表存储持久化或分布式提交。

figures.title: A useful-work denominator
en: Choose a task/quality denominator before claiming efficiency
zh: 声明效率前，先选定任务与质量分母
figures.caption: Workload, quality, failures and recovery belong in the accounting boundary.
figures.caption_cn: 工作负载、质量、失败与恢复都属于统计边界。
figures.formula: Efficiency ledger = cost / qualified useful work

figures.title: Do not sum overlapping phases
figures.title_cn: 不要把重叠的阶段相加
en: Count overlap once in wall-clock time
zh: 墙钟统计只计一次重叠部分
figures.caption: Use a critical-path ledger rather than summing every instrumented duration.
figures.caption_cn: 使用关键路径记录，而不是相加所有被测区间。

figures.title: Energy boundary
zh: 设备 / 板卡 / 系统
figures.caption: Schematic power curve, not measured data; report scope and completed work.
figures.caption_cn: 功率曲线是示意而非实测；报告测量范围与完成工作量。

figures.title: A credible baseline
figures.caption: Use the same workload, resources and correctness contract for both paths.
figures.caption_cn: 两条路径使用相同工作负载、资源与正确性契约。

figures.title: Correctness is a gate
en: Match the oracle to the claimed change
zh: 按所声明变更选择验收标准
figures.caption: A failed correctness gate cannot be traded for higher speed.
figures.caption_cn: 不能用更高速度抵消正确性门槛失败。

figures.title: Ablation and adverse case
figures.caption: Ablate one mechanism and include a workload where the hypothesis may fail.
figures.caption_cn: 隔离一个机制，并加入可能推翻假设的工作负载。

figures.title: AOT deployment choices
en: Compare cold cost, portability and supported operators
zh: 比较冷启动、可移植性与算子支持
figures.caption: Artifact format does not eliminate loader, ABI or kernel requirements.
figures.caption_cn: 产物格式不会消除加载端、ABI 或内核要求。

figures.title: Code search needs an evaluator
figures.caption: Search may propose code but may not relax the acceptance criteria.
figures.caption_cn: 搜索可提议代码，却不能放宽验收条件。

figures.title: Composition needs another experiment
figures.caption: Two separately valid optimizations can interact through layout, state or synchronization.
figures.caption_cn: 两个单独有效的优化可能通过布局、状态或同步产生交互。

figures.title: The CUDA programming model in one slide
figures.title_cn: 一页讲清 CUDA 编程模型
en: A programming model defines how these responsibilities compose
zh: 编程模型规定这些职责如何组合
figures.caption: Joint responsibilities, not an assertion that every accelerator uses CUDA execution.
figures.caption_cn: 联合职责，并不表示每个加速器都采用 CUDA 执行方式。

figures.title: AMD kernel stack: several layers, one runtime
figures.title_cn: AMD 内核栈：多层，一个运行时
figures.caption: A responsibility sketch; supported kernels and backends need target-specific verification.
figures.caption_cn: 职责示意；内核与后端支持需要按目标确认。

figures.title: Edge DSP and NPU stacks: libraries and graph compilers
figures.title_cn: 边缘 DSP 与 NPU 栈：库与图编译器
en: Libraries and graph compilers meet at explicit boundaries
zh: 库与图编译器在明确边界处衔接
figures.caption: DSP/NPU deployment requires a supported toolchain, layout and recovery path.
figures.caption_cn: DSP/NPU 部署需要受支持的工具链、布局与恢复路径。

figures.title: IREE: one compiler, many HAL targets
figures.title_cn: IREE：一个编译器，多个 HAL 目标
figures.caption: A conceptual IREE responsibility path; HAL is not itself a universal firmware ABI.
figures.caption_cn: IREE 职责路径示意；HAL 本身并非通用固件 ABI。

figures.title: TVM: Relax, TensorIR and BYOC
en: Partition boundaries need supported operators and layouts
zh: 分区边界需要受支持的算子与布局
figures.caption: Conceptual TVM paths; BYOC does not supply every unsupported remainder.
figures.caption_cn: TVM 路径示意；BYOC 不会自动补齐所有不支持的算子。

figures.title: OpenXLA: plugin and compiler responsibilities
en: A plugin and a compiler backend have different obligations
zh: 插件与编译器后端有不同职责
figures.caption: Use the retained reference handout for current plugin and backend support.
figures.caption_cn: 当前插件与后端支持请结合备注中的参考手册。

figures.title: GGUF: representation and loading
en: Representation, placement and execution are separate choices
zh: 表示、放置与执行是不同选择
figures.caption: A GGUF responsibility picture, not a claim of universal quantized-kernel support.
figures.caption_cn: GGUF 职责示意，不表示所有量化内核均受支持。

figures.title: vLLM: throughput across many requests
figures.caption: Conceptual serving path; match model, quality and resources when comparing engines.
figures.caption_cn: 服务路径示意；比较引擎时需匹配模型、质量与资源。

figures.title: SGLang: prefix-heavy and structured workloads
figures.title_cn: SGLang：前缀密集与结构化工作负载
figures.caption: Conceptual prefix-heavy execution; current SGLang behavior requires the pinned implementation.
figures.caption_cn: 前缀密集执行示意；当前 SGLang 行为需检查固定版本实现。

figures.title: Prefill and decode expose different work
figures.title_cn: Prefill 与 decode 暴露不同的工作形态
figures.caption: Regimes depend on batch, context, precision and actual kernels.
figures.caption_cn: 具体计算状态取决于批量、上下文、精度与内核。

figures.title: Top-k and top-p need not fully sort
figures.title_cn: Top-k 与 top-p 不必完整排序
en: A full sorted vocabulary is not always required
zh: 并非总需要对整个词表完全排序
figures.caption: Top-k selection example. Top-p additionally applies a cumulative-mass rule; actual kernels depend on the engine.
figures.caption_cn: Top-k 选择示例；top-p 还需要累积概率质量规则，具体内核依引擎而定。

figures.title: Beam search adds hypotheses and state work
figures.title_cn: 束搜索增加候选路径与状态工作
figures.caption: Beam width adds state, candidate selection and reorder work beyond one sequence.
figures.caption_cn: 束宽增加状态、候选选择与重排工作。

figures.title: Choose the right edit surface
figures.caption: The edit surface determines which independent evidence is required.
figures.caption_cn: 修改层次决定所需的独立证据。

figures.title: A test must sometimes reject
figures.title_cn: 测试必须能拒绝错误实现
figures.caption: An evaluator that rejects everything has not demonstrated useful correctness discrimination.
figures.caption_cn: 全部拒绝的验收器没有证明其能有效区分正确与错误。

figures.title: Search budget is part of the outcome
figures.title_cn: 搜索预算也是结果的一部分
en: Account for search costs before claiming an end-to-end gain
zh: 声明端到端收益前，计入搜索成本
figures.caption: Equal boxes name cost categories, not measured shares.
figures.caption_cn: 等宽方框只标记成本类别，不表示实测比例。

figures.title: Choose the numerical oracle first
figures.caption: A CPU reference does not imply universal bit-exact GPU acceptance.
figures.caption_cn: CPU 参考不意味着 GPU 必须普遍位精确匹配。

figures.title: Two graph-testing campaigns
figures.title_cn: 把图测试分成两条路径
en: Preserve seed, graph, versions and minimized reproducer
zh: 保留种子、图、版本与最小复现用例
figures.caption: Valid resource-heavy inputs need separate budgets and exhaustion outcomes.
figures.caption_cn: 合法但耗资源的输入需要单独预算与耗尽结果。

figures.title: A timeout does not end DMA
figures.title_cn: 超时不等于 DMA 已停止
en: A host deadline does not end device ownership
zh: 主机截止时间不会终止设备所有权
figures.caption: Retain buffers until completion or target-supported quiescence establishes safety.
figures.caption_cn: 保留缓冲区，直到完成或目标支持的静止流程确认安全。

figures.title: Design observability before optimization
figures.title_cn: 优化之前先设计可观测性
en: Correlate bounded raw events across ownership boundaries
zh: 跨所有权边界关联有界原始事件
figures.caption: Joint observability responsibilities; measure tracing overhead and preserve definitions.
figures.caption_cn: 联合可观测性职责；测量追踪开销并保留定义。

figures.title: Qualify a layout change on silicon
figures.title_cn: 在真机上验证布局优化
figures.caption: Schematic power curve, not measurements; record operating limits and sampling cadence.
figures.caption_cn: 功率曲线并非实测；记录运行边界与采样间隔。

figures.title: Scale test evidence, then the farm
figures.title_cn: 先扩展证据流程，再扩展机房
zh: 未执行的证据保持“未运行”
figures.caption: A proposed HIL sequence; device deployment requires a supported recoverable setup.
figures.caption_cn: 建议的 HIL 顺序；上设备需要受支持且可恢复的环境。

figures.title: Weight-stationary and output-stationary
figures.caption: Conceptual dataflows; real accelerators may combine or reconfigure stationary choices.
figures.caption_cn: 概念数据流；实际加速器可能组合或重配驻留策略。

figures.title: Array utilization depends on shape
figures.title_cn: 阵列利用率取决于形状
en: Edge tiles may execute work that contributes no useful output
zh: 边缘块可能执行对有效输出无贡献的工作
figures.caption: Illustrative tile occupancy; sustained utilization needs a target measurement.
figures.caption_cn: 块利用率示意；持续利用率需要目标设备测量。

figures.title: The software–hardware mapping contract
en: The compiler must satisfy software and hardware constraints
zh: 编译器必须同时满足软件与硬件约束
figures.caption: Co-design includes scheduling, representation, data movement and verification.
figures.caption_cn: 协同设计涵盖调度、表示、数据移动与验证。
